# Mirage 1.0.4
本版本集中改进登录启动、菜单栏控制、创意工坊浏览和多显示器状态管理，并修复场景与视频壁纸在交互、缩放、透视和系统唤醒后的渲染问题。
## 新增与改进
- 菜单栏图标新增彩色与黑白样式选项；暂停、继续、静音和取消静音状态会即时同步，且这些操作仅对当前运行会话生效，不再改写各壁纸的持久化设置。 - 设置窗口现在会复用同一个面板，并仅在确认后保存修改；取消时会恢复原设置，减少界面重建和无效写入。 - 改进发现页和创意工坊的滚动响应、创作者作品网格尺寸、翻页定位和详情操作布局；优化动态预览缓存和并发加载，降低浏览大量作品时的主线程开销。
## 修复
- 修复“登录时启动”的注册和迁移流程，统一使用 macOS `SMAppService`；登录启动时保持主窗口和 Dock 图标隐藏，手动打开时会转发给已有实例，避免多个 Mirage 进程同时控制桌面。 - 修复 SteamCMD 会话进程在启动或退出后残留并持续累积的问题。 - 修复桌面图片覆盖在截帧、安装、清理和显示器断开重连时的恢复问题；全屏、窗口覆盖、休眠、显示桌面、停止、恢复和播放列表策略现在按显示器独立处理。 - 修复视频壁纸在系统或屏幕唤醒后停滞、丢失播放项或媒体服务重置时无法恢复的问题，加入状态校验和有界重试。 - 修复场景壁纸的指针着色器输入受视差延迟影响的问题，使鼠标交互效果及时响应并正确保留上一帧坐标。 - 修复场景作者设置的动态全局缩放未生效的问题，并确保其可与摄像机路径缩放正确组合。 - 修复透视场景在窗口尺寸或填充模式变化时错误重算视场角的问题，保留作者设定的 FOV，并改进渲染资源切换时的帧同步。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本
当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.4
This release improves login launch behavior, menu bar controls, Workshop browsing, and multi-display state management, while fixing Scene and Video wallpaper rendering across pointer input, zoom, perspective projection, and system wake.
## Improvements
- Added color and monochrome menu bar icon options. Pause, resume, mute, and unmute states now update immediately and apply only to the current session instead of overwriting each wallpaper's persisted settings. - Reused a single Settings panel and deferred persistence until confirmation. Cancelling now restores the previous settings, reducing interface rebuilds and unnecessary writes. - Improved scrolling in Discover and Workshop, creator-grid sizing, page navigation, and detail actions. Animated-preview caching and concurrent loading now reduce main-thread work while browsing large collections.
## Fixes
- Fixed login-item registration and migration by consistently using macOS `SMAppService`. Login launches now keep the main window and Dock icon hidden, while manual opens are forwarded to the existing instance so multiple Mirage processes cannot control the desktop at once. - Fixed SteamCMD session processes remaining behind and accumulating after app launches or exits. - Fixed desktop-picture override recovery across frame capture, installation, cleanup, and display disconnects or reconnects. Fullscreen, window coverage, sleep, Show Desktop, stop, resume, and playlist policies are now evaluated independently per display. - Fixed Video wallpapers failing to resume after system or display wake, losing their player item, or failing after a media-services reset by adding state verification and bounded recovery retries. - Fixed Scene wallpaper pointer shader inputs inheriting parallax delay, restoring immediate interaction and correct previous-frame coordinates. - Fixed authored animated global Scene zoom and its composition with camera-path zoom. - Fixed perspective Scenes recalculating authored field of view when the window size or fill mode changed, preserving the intended FOV and improving frame synchronization during render-resource transitions.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.0.3
本版本集中改进壁纸播放控制、创意工坊筛选和 macOS 系统集成，并修复多显示器、屏保和网页壁纸播放的稳定性问题。
## 新增与改进
- 已安装壁纸新增“最近添加”排序，方便快速找到刚下载或导入的壁纸 (#16)。 - 创意工坊新增“最热门（本月）”和“最热门（今年）”趋势范围，并补充分辨率筛选和文本相关性排序 (#10)。 - 设置新增隐藏菜单栏图标选项 (#15)。 - 设置新增 HDR 视频选项，在支持 EDR 的显示器上启用 HDR 视频输出。 - 设置新增“窗口覆盖屏幕超过阈值时暂停”，并改进焦点、全屏、音频、显示器休眠和电池状态下的播放策略。 - 新增开发模式实时日志，自动对 API Key、Token、密码等敏感信息脱敏；登录项在临时签名环境下提供 LaunchAgent 回退，并同步系统状态和错误提示。
## 修复
- 修复网页壁纸在暂停、恢复、切换和激活过程中的音频状态不同步问题。 - 修复视频壁纸及屏保视频的解码和播放流程；转换缓存现在会校验源文件时间，避免使用过期缓存，并保留原始视频文件。 - 修复场景和网页壁纸快照为空或被重复回放时的异常，减少不必要的渲染器资源重建。 - 修复桌面覆盖刷新、多显示器休眠状态和全屏窗口检测，提升自动暂停和恢复的准确性。 - 修复已安装、发现和创意工坊页面之间切换时的视图状态、卡片交互和预览状态稳定性。 - 改进 SteamCMD 下载结果校验及错误提示，并补充相关本地化文本。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 系统要求：macOS 14.2 或更高版本
当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.0.3
This release improves wallpaper playback controls, Workshop discovery, and macOS integration, while stabilizing multi-display, screen saver, and web wallpaper playback.
## Improvements
- Added a **Recently Added** sort order for installed wallpapers, making newly downloaded or imported wallpapers easier to find (#16). - Added **Most Popular (Month)** and **Most Popular (Year)** Workshop trend periods, plus resolution filters and text-relevance sorting (#10). - Added a setting to hide the menu bar icon (#15). - Added an HDR video setting that enables HDR output on EDR-capable displays. - Added **Pause when windows cover more than the threshold**, and improved playback policy handling for focus, fullscreen windows, audio, display sleep, and battery state. - Added live Developer Mode logs with automatic redaction of API keys, tokens, passwords, and similar sensitive values. Login items now fall back to a LaunchAgent for ad-hoc builds and keep system status and error messages synchronized.
## Fixes
- Fixed web wallpaper audio state getting out of sync while pausing, resuming, switching, or activating wallpapers. - Fixed video wallpaper and screen saver decoding/playback; conversion caches now validate the source modification time, avoid stale cached media, and preserve the original video. - Fixed blank or redundantly replayed Scene and Web wallpaper snapshots, reducing unnecessary renderer resource rebuilds. - Fixed desktop-override refresh, multi-display sleep state, and fullscreen-window detection for more accurate automatic pause and resume behavior. - Fixed view state, card interaction, and preview stability when switching between Installed, Discover, and Workshop pages. - Improved SteamCMD download-result validation and error messages, with additional localization coverage.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - Requires macOS 14.2 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
